summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint configuration but declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that runs an obfuscated script with hex-named identifiers. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, writes it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js (execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})). If Bun is already installed on the host it is used directly. math_init.js is a ~727KB file headed with '// @bun @bun-cjs' and uses obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (WV8StW over a large constant table), making the payload not human-readable. Nothing in the package's stated purpose (an ESLint config) requires a second language runtime or an opaque bundled binary payload, and both the loader and the payload are obfuscated. Installing the package causes automatic execution of this payload under a runtime that Node-based scanners do not observe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
